arguments.command:
cd /tmp && SYNECDOCHE_SITE=/workspace/site LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/site python3 /workspace/submission/run.py < <(python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(open('/workspace/examples.json'))
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(d[0]['request'],separators=(',',':')))
") > /tmp/out.json; echo "rc=$?"; python3 -c "
import json
got=json.load(open('/tmp/out.json'))
exp=json.load(open('/workspace/examples.json'))[0]['response']
print('MATCH' if got==exp else 'MISMATCH')
import difflib
if got!=exp:
    a=json.dumps(got,indent=1,sort_keys=True).splitlines()
    b=json.dumps(exp,indent=1,sort_keys=True).splitlines()
    print('\n'.join(list(difflib.unified_diff(b,a,'exp','got'))[:60]))
"
